findings: Composite board combines four assets; canonical release requires individual governed production masters.
Environmental panel embeds generalized growth-stage temperature/RH/VPD ranges that the canonical lesson explicitly avoids presenting as universal cultivation commands.
PPFD panel embeds example numeric canopy targets/map values that are not part of the canonical lesson copy lock.
Sensor panel includes prescriptive placement language that exceeds the lesson's contextual representativeness framing.
Alarm panel includes target ranges and corrective-action wording that can imply independent control authority beyond Technician I boundaries.
Branding says Cannabis Training Academy instead of the approved THC Learning Hub/Course 3 vocabulary.
Generated visible copy does not exactly match canonical captions, terminology and authority language.
disposition: Do not publish or cut lessons over to this board. Use only as composition/reference direction for four separate rebuilt masters.

requiredRebuilds.title: Environmental measurement context
copyRules: VPD is contextual atmospheric drying-demand information.
Keep supplied target, observed measurement and alarm roles distinct.
No growth-stage target table or universal VPD range.

requiredRebuilds.title: Repeatable canopy PPFD grid
copyRules: Show a repeatable canopy grid and measurement method.
Use PPFD units correctly if values are displayed.
Emphasize distribution rather than one center point.
No universal PPFD target or flowering-week prescription.

requiredRebuilds.title: Sensor placement and representativeness triage
copyRules: Contrast representative and locally biased measurements.
Compare peers and verification status before control changes.
No universal sensor height or unauthorized calibration/repair instruction.

requiredRebuilds.title: Alarm, trend, verification and handoff workflow
copyRules: Distinguish current value, average, trend and alarm.
Alarm is evidence of a rule event, not a diagnosis.
Record permitted verification, unresolved condition, escalation and next action.
No universal alarm targets or independent corrective-control instruction.
